name: Hiroki Tanaka
bio:
Hiroki Tanaka's journey into motorsport finance was somewhat accidental, initially training as a chartered accountant, he was drawn to the high-stakes, fast-paced environment of racing. A chance encounter with a CLRT by Almeras executive at a business seminar led to an offer he couldn't refuse. He brings a meticulous approach to budget management, cost analysis, and financial forecasting, ensuring the team remains competitive while adhering to strict financial guidelines.

Tanaka-san's strength lies in his ability to see beyond the immediate numbers, understanding the long-term financial implications of technical upgrades and strategic investments. He is known for his innovative financing models and his advocacy for sustainable spending within the team. His loyalty to CLRT by Almeras is unwavering, a core part of his professional identity. He is not easily swayed by impulsive decisions and is a calm and collected voice in critical financial decisions.

What sets Tanaka-san apart is his deep understanding of Japanese business philosophy, emphasizing long-term growth and strategic partnerships. He is a bridge between the team's ambition and financial reality, making him an invaluable asset to CLRT by Almeras.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Hiroki is of average height, with a thoughtful expression usually present.

quirks: Always carries a traditional Japanese abacus for quick calculations, despite using modern software.
Insists on starting every financial meeting with a traditional Japanese tea ceremony.
Methodically organizes his desk supplies by color and size.
